The fix parses each format explicitly.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.93,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS

  SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount,
         CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{4} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}$') THEN strptime(txn_ts, '%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S')
